title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes, bump versions (py/ts/go)
author: Asha Menon
description:
Summary:
Unify auth and retry primitives across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; improve streaming API ergonomics (backpressure and reconnect behavior); apply parity fixes where implementations diverged; and bump SDK versions for a coordinated release.

Motivation:
- Multiple customer-reported issues showed inconsistent retry semantics between SDKs (different backoff defaults, retryable code sets).
- Streaming ergonomics (especially for the TS SDK) made it difficult to handle reconnects and incremental partial messages in server-sent events usage.
- Several small behavioral diffs between SDKs caused support noise and test flakes.

What this PR does:
- Introduces a shared auth token refresh interface and a single set of default retry/backoff parameters codified in each SDK.
- Adds streaming utilities: a ReconnectStrategy, explicit onMessage/onPartial/onClose callbacks, and cleaner cancellation semantics.
- Fixes parity issues: consistent error wrapping, identical error types/names, and uniform field names in generated response objects.
- Bumps versions: python -> 1.36.0, typescript -> 1.36.0, go -> v1.36.0.

Checklist:
- [x] Align retry/backoff defaults across SDKs
- [x] Add regression tests for auth refresh during active streaming
- [x] Add TS streaming reconnect tests (mock server)
- [x] Update changelogs and release notes
- [x] Run full integration test matrix (x86/GPU/arm where applicable)

Files of interest (high-level):
- sdk/python/redwood/auth.py: new TokenRefresher interface + impl, tighten TTL handling.
- sdk/python/redwood/retries.py: unified RetryPolicy with exponential_jitter.
- sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py: StreamingClient additions + tests/test_streaming_reconnect.py.
- sdk/typescript/src/auth.ts: TokenProvider abstraction + tests.
- sdk/typescript/src/streaming.ts: new ReconnectStrategy and stream ergonomics helpers.
- sdk/go/redwood/auth.go: token refresher interface + concurrent-safe cache.
- sdk/go/redwood/retries.go: RetryPolicy and Backoff implementation parity.
- packages/versions.txt: bumped versions for coordinated release.

Commits summary:
- a1b2c3d: introduce shared retry constants and document rationale
- d4e5f6a: python auth token refresher + tests
- f7g8h9i: typescript streaming reconnect and partial-message handling
- j0k1l2m: go retry parity + error type alignment
- n3o4p5q: bump versions and changelogs

Notes/compatibility:
- Default retry/backoff values changed (longer max backoff, more conservative default attempts). This is intended to reduce accidental request amplification; documented in changelogs.
- API surface changes for streaming are additive (new helpers and options). Existing usages should continue to work; however, customers relying on previously undocumented partial-message semantics should be notified.
- No breaking security changes. Auth interfaces are additive; token refresh now required to be thread-safe (documented).

Testing:
- Unit tests added across all SDKs (python/ts/go).
- Integration tests run against mock server and internal staging API.
- CI initially flaked on typescript streaming integration (race in mock server); fixed by introducing a deterministic handshake in tests.

Related:
- Linear: ENG-1234 (SDK parity), ENG-2345 (streaming ergonomics), PM-987 (coordinated release).
- Support ticket: SUP-4321 (customer reported retry inconsistency).

Release notes (short):
- SDKs: Unify auth & retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; improve streaming API ergonomics and reconnect behavior; minor parity fixes and version bumps to 1.36.0.
